examples.english: To let someone join the group.

notes:
{混|ま}ぜる is an ichidan transitive verb meaning to mix or blend.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {混|ま}ざる (intransitive, to be mixed)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- よく{混|ま}ぜる: to mix well
- {軽|かる}く{混|ま}ぜる: to mix lightly
- 〜に{混|ま}ぜる: to mix into ~
- {仲間|なかま}に{混|ま}ぜる: to let someone join the group

COOKING USES:
- {卵|たまご}を{混|ま}ぜる: to beat eggs
- {材料|ざいりょう}を{混|ま}ぜる: to mix ingredients
- ヘラで{混|ま}ぜる: to mix with a spatula

SIMILAR VERBS:
- かき{混|ま}ぜる: to stir (more vigorous)
- {混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせる: to combine, blend together
- {交|ま}ぜる: alternate kanji, same meaning
